1	# The State of Global Education: Progress, Gaps, and Inequality
     2	
     3	A data-driven comparison of how education access, quality, and equity have evolved worldwide — and where critical challenges remain.
     4	
     5	## Two Centuries of Educational Expansion
     6	
     7	In the early 1800s, fewer than 1 in 5 adults worldwide had received any formal education. Education was a luxury reserved for a small elite. Over the past two centuries, this ratio has reversed dramatically. Today, more than 4 in 5 adults (aged 15+) have received some formal primary, secondary, or tertiary education. Literacy rates have followed a similar trajectory: two centuries ago, very few could read and write; now, the vast majority of adults possess basic literacy skills.
     8	
     9	## The Learning Crisis: Being in School ≠ Learning
    10	
    11	International statistics often track enrollment and attendance as markers of progress. However, being enrolled does not guarantee quality learning. In many lower-income countries, fewer than 20% of children achieve minimum reading proficiency by the end of primary school — meaning they cannot identify key ideas in a text or connect them to their own experiences. The data reveals a stark learning crisis hidden behind enrollment numbers.
    12	
    13	## 244 Million Children Still Out of School
    14	
    15	Despite enormous progress, approximately 244 million children of official school age were not enrolled in primary or secondary education in 2023. A major driver is secondary-level dropout: many children who complete primary school do not continue. The following table summarizes the scale of the challenge:
    16	
    17	| Indicator | Value (2023) |
    18	|---|---|
    19	| Children out of school (all levels) | ~244 million |
    20	| Primary-age children out of school | ~60 million |
    21	| Secondary-age adolescents out of school | ~184 million |
    22	
    23	## Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling: A World Divided
    24	
    25	Researchers combine the quantity and quality of education into a single metric called "learning-adjusted years of schooling." The disparities are enormous:
    26	
    27	| Country Group | Learning-Adjusted Years of Schooling (2020) |
    28	|---|---|
    29	| Poorest countries (parts of Sub-Saharan Africa) | < 3 years |
    30	| South Asia & Sub-Saharan Africa average | < 7 years |
    31	| High-income countries | 10+ years |
    32	
    33	Children in the world's poorest nations receive less than a third of the quality schooling available to their peers in wealthy countries. Most of the world's children live in South Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa, where the average remains below 7 years.
    34	
    35	## Closing the Gender Gap
    36	
    37	Historically, boys were far more likely to attend school than girls. Today, the global gender gap in enrollment has largely closed across primary and secondary education. At the tertiary level, young women are now more likely to be enrolled than young men.
    38	
    39	| Education Level | Gender Gap Status (2023) |
    40	|---|---|
    41	| Primary | Nearly closed globally |
    42	| Secondary | Nearly closed globally |
    43	| Tertiary | Women now exceed men in enrollment |
    44	
    45	However, significant exceptions persist. In countries like Afghanistan, girls remain far less likely to attend school at any level.
    46	
    47	## Key Takeaway
    48	
    49	The world has achieved remarkable progress — but the job is far from done. Hundreds of millions of children are either out of school or learning very little while in it. Closing the gap between enrollment and actual learning, and between rich and poor nations, is one of the most pressing challenges of our time.

python3 -c "
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import os

# A1 portrait at 150 dpi = 1754 x 2480
W, H = 1754, 2480

# Colors
bg = '#1a2332'         # deep navy/charcoal
bg_light = '#232d3f'   # slightly lighter for cards
accent_amber = '#f4a261' # warm amber for progress
accent_coral = '#e76f51' # coral for crisis/urgency
text_white = '#f0f0f0'
text_gray = '#a0aec0'
text_light_gray = '#8899aa'

img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), bg)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Try to load fonts
try:
    font_bold = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf', 120)
    font_large = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf', 200)
    font_num = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf', 240)
    font_title = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf', 64)
    font_subtitle = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf', 40)
    font_body = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf', 32)
    font_small = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf', 28)
    font_tiny = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf', 24)
except Exception as e:
    print('Font load error:', e)
    font_bold = ImageFont.load_default()
    font_large = font_bold
    font_num = font_bold
    font_title = font_bold
    font_subtitle = font_bold
    font_body = font_bold
    font_small = font_bold
    font_tiny = font_bold

# Helper: draw rounded rect
def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill, outline=None, width=1):
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = xy
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

# Helper: center text
def text_size(draw, text, font):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0,0), text, font=font)
    return bbox[2]-bbox[0], bbox[3]-bbox[1]

# ===== HEADER =====
y = 60
# Title
title = 'THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION'
tw, th = text_size(draw, title, font_bold)
draw.text(((W-tw)//2, y), title, font=font_bold, fill=text_white)
y += th + 10
# Subtitle
subtitle = 'Progress, Gaps, and Inequality'
sw, sh = text_size(draw, subtitle, font_subtitle)
draw.text(((W-sw)//2, y), subtitle, font=font_subtitle, fill=text_gray)
y += sh + 50

# Thin accent line
draw.line([(W//2 - 300, y), (W//2 + 300, y)], fill=accent_amber, width=4)
y += 50

# ===== SECTION 1: HISTORICAL PROGRESS =====
# Card background
card_margin = 80
card_y = y
card_h = 340
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (card_margin, card_y, W-card_margin, card_y+card_h), 20, bg_light)

# Section title
sec_title = 'TWO CENTURIES OF EDUCATIONAL EXPANSION'
stw, sth = text_size(draw, sec_title, font_title)
draw.text(((W-stw)//2, card_y+25), sec_title, font=font_title, fill=accent_amber)

# Big numbers side by side
box_w = (W - 2*card_margin - 80) // 2
# Left: 1800
x1 = card_margin + 40
y1 = card_y + 100
num1 = '< 1 in 5'
label1 = 'Adults educated (1800)'
n1w, n1h = text_size(draw, num1, font_large)
draw.text((x1 + (box_w-n1w)//2, y1), num1, font=font_large, fill=accent_coral)
l1w, l1h = text_size(draw, label1, font_body)
draw.text((x1 + (box_w-l1w)//2, y1+n1h+10), label1, font=font_body, fill=text_gray)

# Arrow
arrow_x = x1 + box_w + 20
arrow_y = y1 + n1h//2
draw.text((arrow_x, arrow_y-40), '→', font=font_large, fill=text_white)

# Right: Today
x2 = arrow_x + 60
num2 = '> 4 in 5'
label2 = 'Adults educated (today)'
n2w, n2h = text_size(draw, num2, font_large)
draw.text((x2 + (box_w-n2w)//2, y1), num2, font=font_large, fill=accent_amber)
l2w, l2h = text_size(draw, label2, font_body)
draw.text((x2 + (box_w-l2w)//2, y1+n2h+10), label2, font=font_body, fill=text_gray)

# Body text
body1 = 'In the early 1800s, education was a luxury for a small elite. Today, the vast majority of adults possess basic literacy skills.'
b1w, b1h = text_size(draw, body1, font_small)
draw.text(((W-b1w)//2, card_y+card_h-70), body1, font=font_small, fill=text_light_gray)

y = card_y + card_h + 50

# ===== SECTION 2: OUT OF SCHOOL (DOMINANT) =====
card_y = y
card_h = 420
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (card_margin, card_y, W-card_margin, card_y+card_h), 20, bg_light)

# Section title
sec2_title = '244 MILLION CHILDREN STILL OUT OF SCHOOL'
st2w, st2h = text_size(draw, sec2_title, font_title)
draw.text(((W-st2w)//2, card_y+25), sec2_title, font=font_title, fill=accent_coral)

# Big number
big_num = '244 MILLION'
bnw, bnh = text_size(draw, big_num, font_num)
draw.text(((W-bnw)//2, card_y+95), big_num, font=font_num, fill=accent_coral)

# Sub-label
bl = 'Children of official school age not enrolled in primary or secondary education (2023)'
blw, blh = text_size(draw, bl, font_small)
draw.text(((W-blw)//2, card_y+95+bnh+10), bl, font=font_small, fill=text_gray)

# Breakdown bars
bar_y = card_y + 95 + bnh + 60
bar_h = 50
total = 244
primary = 60
secondary = 184
bar_max_w = W - 2*card_margin - 200

# Primary bar
p_w = int(bar_max_w * (primary/total))
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (card_margin+100, bar_y, card_margin+100+p_w, bar_y+bar_h), 10, accent_amber)
p_label = f'Primary-age: ~{primary} million'
plw, plh = text_size(draw, p_label, font_small)
draw.text((card_margin+100+15, bar_y+(bar_h-plh)//2), p_label, font=font_small, fill=bg)

# Secondary bar
s_w = int(bar_max_w * (secondary/total))
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (card_margin+100, bar_y+bar_h+15, card_margin+100+s_w, bar_y+2*bar_h+15), 10, accent_coral)
s_label = f'Secondary-age: ~{secondary} million'
slw, slh = text_size(draw, s_label, font_small)
draw.text((card_margin+100+15, bar_y+bar_h+15+(bar_h-slh)//2), s_label, font=font_small, fill=bg)

# Right side: icon array hint (small circles)
ic_x = W - card_margin - 180
for row in range(4):
    for col in range(5):
        cx = ic_x + col*30
        cy = bar_y + row*30
        draw.ellipse([cx, cy, cx+18, cy+18], fill=accent_coral if row*5+col < 4 else text_gray)

y = card_y + card_h + 50

# ===== SECTION 3: QUALITY INEQUALITY =====
card_y = y
card_h = 380
draw_rounded_rect(draw, (card_margin, card_y, W-card_margin, card_y+card_h), 20, bg_light)

sec3_title = 'LEARNING-ADJUSTED YEARS OF SCHOOLING: A WORLD DIVIDED'
st3w, st3h = text_size(draw, sec3_title, font_title)
draw.text(((W-st3w)//2, card_y+25), sec3_title, font=font_title, fill=text_white)

# Side by side comparison
box_w = (W - 2*card_margin - 80) // 2
x1 = card_margin + 40
y1 = card_y + 100

# Poorest
pnum = '< 3 years'
plab = 'Poorest countries\n(parts of Sub-Saharan Africa)'
pnw, pnh = text_size(draw, pnum, font_large)
draw.text((x1 + (box_w-pnw)//2, y1), pnum, font=font_large, fill=accent_coral)
plines = plab.split('\\n')
for i, line in enumerate(plines):
    lw, lh = text_size(draw, line, font_body)
    draw.text((x1 + (box_w-lw)//2, y1+pnh+20+i*(lh+5)), line, font=font_body, fill=text_gray)

# Visual bar underneath
bar_w = box_w - 60
bar_h = 30
bar_y = y1 + pnh + 20 + len(plines)*45 + 20
draw.rounded_rectangle((x1+(box_w-bar_w)//2, bar_y, x1+(box_w-bar_w)//2+int(bar_w*0.25), bar_y+bar_h), 8, fill=accent_coral)
draw.rounded_rectangle((x1+(box_w-bar_w)//2+int(bar_w*0.25), bar_y, x1+(box_w-bar_w)//2+bar_w, bar_y+bar_h), 8, fill=bg)

# Rich
x2 = x1 + box_w + 80
rnum = '10+ years'
rlab = 'High-income countries'
rnw, rnh = text_size(draw, rnum, font_large)
draw.text((x2 + (box_w-rnw)//2, y1), rnum, font=font_large, fill=accent_amber)
lw, lh = text_size(draw, rlab, font_body)
draw.text((x2 + (box_w-lw)//2, y1+rnh+20), rlab, font=font_body, fill=text_gray)
